name: How much does basement drywall finishing cost in Denver or Parker?
description: A common Denver-area range is about $3 to $6 per square foot for basement drywall finishing. Bigger, more complex, or moisture-sensitive projects cost more.

mainEntity.name: How much does basement drywall finishing cost in Denver or Parker?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver area, basement drywall finishing commonly runs about $3 to $6 per square foot when framing, drywall, taping, and finishing are included. The final price changes with ceiling height, finish level, moisture-resistant materials, and how much repair or prep the basement needs.
